name: HubDev Buddy
author: HubDev
description: The state of your HubDev environment at a glance in the bar: sites, services, PHP versions, Caddy and Docker. Quiet when healthy, obvious when broken.

barWidget.description: One bar mark that gains a coloured dot only when something in the local HubDev environment is wrong.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll HubDev while the panel is closed. The panel itself refreshes faster while open.

schema.label: Panel layout
schema.description: Dense is a compact table; columns is wider and splits sites, services and environment side by side.
